svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Enif
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap. Wherever you go, you always bring so much warmth and care to everyone around you, and your energy is just amazing. I hope this year brings you so much happiness, good health, and great things in your career and love life.

g.title: Insomniac11
g.desc: Happy Birthdayyy! 🥂🎂 Even though we haven't really crossed paths, a birthday is always a good excuse to send some good wishes your way. Hope this new chapter brings you endless happiness, beautiful surprises, genuine people and countless reasons to smile. May you have the loveliest day and an even lovelier year ahead. Stay blessed! ♡

g.title: dru
g.desc: i heard it was a bad bitch birthday? happiest birthday, siren! 💋

g.title: Voir
g.desc: Happiest nd craziest birthday ever Trap 🎉🎆!! May the chapters in your life be full of happy memories and never cease to exist!! 💯✨

g.title: syeu
g.desc: Happy birthday! wishing you all the best !

g.title: As_DeCoeur_
g.desc: Happy Birthday Trap enjoy your day, it's your moment !

g.title: Akindun
g.desc: Trap, you absolute blessing in disguise. You make ordinary moments feel special, and your presence makes things a little brighter. Never change that beautiful energy of yours. ❤️
